rule: Painterly/faceted atmosphere owns passive architecture. Adult-comic edge and deterministic state begin at a documented operated object, content/result, host or continuation boundary.

boundaries.fallback: titles, statuses, departments, save and open controls remain
host name, question, answer and route remain
all destinations remain named and operable
reader uses no required raster art

responsiveRule: The same selectors and DOM order own desktop, 390px, 320px and 720px zoom-equivalent states; measured boxes are bound in geometry-parity.json.
governanceCheck: A C placement is rejected if the graphic edge extends into passive architecture without a documented hit area/content role, or if an operated object lacks the shared edge, focus, fallback and contact-shadow contract.
